brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a technician visit to inspect and repair a central heating unit that is blowing cold air.
facts: The central heating unit stopped heating and is blowing room-temperature air.
The home address is 742 Evergreen Terrace.
The homeowner's name is Alex Mercer.
preferences: Prefers a morning appointment slot if available.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, which will be invoiced afterwards rather than paid on the call

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, new installations on 2, billing on 3.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated IVR
script.text: Thank you for calling Precision Heating and Cooling. For service, press 1. For new installations, press 2. For billing, press 3.

script.label: Front Desk Rep (Greg)
script.text: Thanks for calling Precision Heating and Cooling service scheduling, my name is Greg. How can I help you today?

script.label: Front Desk Rep (Greg)
script.text: I can certainly get someone scheduled for you. May I have your name and the service address?

script.label: Front Desk Rep (Greg)
script.text: Thank you. Let me transfer you directly to our lead dispatcher, Karen, to lock in your appointment time.

script.label: Dispatcher (Karen)
script.text: Hello Alex, this is Karen in dispatch. Greg noted that your heating unit is blowing cold air.

script.label: Dispatcher (Karen)
script.text: I have an opening with our technician Mark tomorrow between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

script.label: Dispatcher (Karen)
script.text: Just to let you know, we do not quote prices over the phone; all diagnostic and repair charges are invoiced after the service is completed.

script.label: Dispatcher (Karen)
script.text: What is the best phone number for Mark to call when he is on his way?

script.label: Dispatcher (Karen)
script.text: You are all set for tomorrow, between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM at 742 Evergreen Terrace. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

script.label: Dispatcher (Karen)
script.text: Thank you for choosing Precision Heating and Cooling. Stay warm, and have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
